name: Apollo 17 (Taurus-Littrow): artifact boundary (225 m)
rationale: NASA 2011 §A3-2: 'the exclusion zone extends 225 meters from the lunar module descent stage; visits to any part of the site are prohibited'. Centred on the LM descent stage (LROC coordinates).

sources.label: NASA (2011, Rev A 28 Oct 2011), Recommendations to Space-Faring Entities: How to Protect and Preserve the Historic and Scientific Value of U.S. Government Lunar Artifacts
LROC, Coordinates of Lunar Anthropogenic Targets (28 Jul 2016; Wagner et al. 2017, Icarus 283:92-103)
